text:
alex: Heads-up — we need to re-open the MVP cutlist after the Acme sync. they pushed a hard date and asked for SSO + audit logs in MVP.

maya: Which deadline did they give? @alex

alex: They said ‘end of next quarter’, effectively 3 weeks earlier than our current milestone. LOI pending.

sam: SSO + audit logs is a pretty big ask for MVP. Could we scope SSO core (OIDC passthrough) in MVP and push audit logs to v1 unless they commit? :thinking:

sylvia: Agree with @sam. Also want to flag that audit logs touches bulk storage and retention policy which impacts compliance review.

alex: My recommendation: keep MVP focused on auth core + SSO passthrough, defer audit logs and telemetry to v1. Offer Acme a phased promise: SSO in MVP, audit logs gated on LOI/paid commit.

maya: That sounds defensible. If Acme needs audit logs for contract, we should model the timeline impact before agreeing.

sam: I'll draft two cutlist options:

A) MVP-minimal (auth core + SSO passthrough) — no audit logs, no enhanced telemetry. safe for current timeline.

B) MVP-expanded (auth core + SSO + basic audit logs retention=30d) — ~+3 weeks, needs infra + compliance signoff.

sam: Quick tech note:
```
MVP-expanded-impact:
  infra: +1x db shard, +1 retention-store
  infra-cost: ~+$8k/mo
  risk: compliance signoff
```

dev-bot: Note: auth-service canary scheduled 2025-09-21 03:00 UTC — ensure no breaking changes for MVP cut.

sylvia: If Acme signs LOI we should consider a formal 4-week timeline reset and trade non-customer-facing items (e.g., UX polish, advanced telemetry) to absorb the audit work.

maya: Action items: @sam to post the two cutlist options with estimated delta (time/cost/risk) by EOD. @alex to confirm LOI timeline and share exact customer asks. We'll reconvene tomorrow 10:30 to pick path. :thumbsup:
